title: LiteMedSAM improves mean CT overlap, with three organ regressions
claim: On one fixed CT case, a fresh Astra/medium plus LiteMedSAM condition achieved macro Dice0.75697 versus0.73419 for standalone Astra/medium, improving seven organs and worsening three. All frozen scores replay exactly. Active tool use did not remove localization and small-organ errors.
limitations: Single case and one attempt per condition; no general ranking or causal tool effect.
Skill/runtime/weights together change the intervention and task digest.
Same public CT was used for prior oracle-box calibration, withheld from this agent; model training overlap unknown.
Research GT not independent clinical adjudication.
Boundary-distance and prompt-coverage metrics are post-hoc diagnostics, not changed frozen scores.
Correct matched names are conditional on geometry.
No observed external retrieval does not exclude training exposure or opaque service traffic.
